from tool import search_flights, filter_flights, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve previously cached flight results for outbound and return legs
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")

# Filter outbound flights for first-class preference and departure time after 04:37 PM
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=departure_flights,
    flight_class=["first"],
    departure_time=["16:37:00", "23:59:00"]
)

# Filter return flights for first-class preference and departure time after 04:37 PM
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["first"],
    departure_time=["16:37:00", "23:59:00"]
)

# Save filtered results back to cache with unique keys
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure_flights)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return_flights)

# Output summary to user
print("No planning needed")
